arabic text: SURAE KAHF SUNATA HAI YE SAR KISKA HAI
english translation text: RECITING SURAH KAHF, WHOSE HEAD IS THIS?

arabic text: KHOON ANKHO SE BAHATA HAI.YE SAR KISKA HAI
english translation text: CRYING TEARS OF BLOOD, WHOSE HEAD IS THIS?

arabic text: CHALTE CHALTE JO SAKINA (S.A.) KAHI GIR JATI HAI
english translation text: WHENEVER SAKINA FALLS WHILE SHE IS WALKING

arabic text: KHUDKO NAIZE SE GIRATA HAI. YE SAR KISKA HAI
english translation text: IT THROWS ITSELF OFF THE SPEAR, WHOSE HEAD IS THIS?

arabic text: JIS TARAF JATA HAI BAZAR ME SAR AKBAR (A.S.) KA
english translation text: WHICHEVER WAY THE HEAD OF AKBAR GOES IN THE BAZAAR,

arabic text: US TARAF DEKHTA JATA HAI. YE SAR KISKA HAI
english translation text: IT KEEPS LOOKING THAT WAY, WHOSE HEAD IS THIS?

arabic text: RAAT HOTI HAI TO MASOOM SI EK BACHI KO
english translation text: WHEN IT BECOMES DARK, TO THIS LITTLE INNOCENT GIRL

arabic text: LORI NAIZE SE SUNATA HAI YE SAR KISKA HAI
english translation text: IT SINGS LULLABIES FROM THE TOP OF THE SPEAR, WHOSE HEAD IS THIS?

arabic text: YE SAMA KAASH NA DEKHE KOI KHWAHAR ISKI
english translation text: IF ONLY ANY SISTER OF HIS WAS NOT PRESENT TO SEE THIS MOMENT

arabic text: SHIMR (L.A.) ZULFO SE UTHATA HAI YE SAR KISKA HAI
english translation text: SHIMR IS PICKING IT UP BY ITS HAIR, WHOSE HEAD IS THIS?
